cleared.name: PAS FACILE
cleared.line: A Paris magazine and lifestyle label. The shop, the lookbook and a playable game all live on one page, so nobody has to navigate to be sold to.
detail: The hero is a live Three.js shader. Mouse speed drives a ripple through the image, and it degrades to a plain photograph when a device cannot run WebGL, so nobody gets a blank screen.
The lookbook pins and scrolls sideways under one trigger. Nine looks in the space a normal page gives three, which is how a small catalogue reads as a full collection.
Drop 001 takes real orders. Hover swaps the product image, quick add works from the grid, and the cart survives a reload so a half-finished basket is still there tomorrow.
PAS FACILE RUN is a canvas game inside the page, with a monthly leaderboard and a real prize. It exists because a reason to come back beats a reason to visit once.

cleared.name: NOOR PERFUMES
cleared.line: An Antwerp maison for rare Arabian extraits. The flacon in the hero is real 3D in the browser, not a photograph, so it turns as the visitor moves.

cleared.name: UCHI
cleared.line: Booking built into the site instead of handed to a widget. It knows a cut plus a colour plus a wash is one visit, and that two colour processes are not.

cleared.name: Tandis
cleared.line: A practice on the Lange Gasthuisstraat that explains the treatment before it quotes it. Appointments hand off to the Doctena account they already run.

cleared.name: La Framboise
cleared.line: Every item on the menu is marked up with its own price and section, so search engines can answer what a loaf costs without anyone opening the site.

cleared.name: Dermadok
cleared.line: Seven doctors, one clinic on Het Eilandje, and a visitor who needs to find the right one fast. Dutch and English from a single build.

cleared.name: Josh Stefs
cleared.line: Three singles, one a year. The lit window in the record sleeve is the play button, and pressing it runs the page backwards through his three years.

cleared.name: LACLINIC DENTAL
cleared.line: No patient stop and no waiting list, said plainly on the page, because that is the one thing a person in pain is searching for.

cleared.name: Kaiso Sushi
cleared.line: A full sushi menu on Klapdorp, every dish its own page in both languages, filterable before anyone picks up the phone to ask what is in it.

cleared.name: Bravo Dent
cleared.line: A practice on the Turnhoutsebaan. Opening hours, address and ratings are marked up as data, so Google prints them straight into the result.

cleared.name: Elite Clinics
cleared.line: Nineteen Dutch routes with a full English mirror, one treatment per page, so each procedure can rank for the thing people actually type.

cleared.name: Labi
cleared.line: Open until 22:00, which is the whole pitch, so it leads. Hours and prices come from the booking system the shop already uses.

cleared.name: Visuals by Fiets
cleared.line: The motion and VFX arm of the same shop. Every price is on the page, because a rate card answers the first question a client has.
